en.headline: Gazette order requires removal of 2019 remains from six public cemeteries
en.dek: Families who wish to arrange private exhumation must apply by 29 August; otherwise the remains will be cremated and the ashes buried at Sandy Ridge or another designated site.
body: The government gazetted an order on Friday directing the removal and disposal of human remains buried in 2019 at six public cemeteries.

The order was made under section 119A of the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance, which empowers the Director of Food and Environmental Hygiene to require the removal of remains that have been buried for not less than six years.

The sites affected are the coffin sections of Wo Hop Shek Cemetery in Fanling, Cheung Chau Cemetery, Tai O Cemetery and Lai Chi Yuen Cemetery on Lantau, together with the ‘T’ Section of Sandy Ridge Cemetery and the Government Urn Section of Sandy Ridge Urn Cemetery in Lo Wu.

Anyone wishing to arrange private exhumation and disposal must apply in person at the department’s Cemeteries and Crematoria Office in Hung Hom on or before 29 August. Remains not claimed will be cremated at a government crematorium and the ashes buried at Sandy Ridge Urn Cemetery or another site decided by the Director.

zh.headline: 憲報公告須移走2019年安葬六個公眾墳場先人遺骸
zh.dek: 家屬如欲自行撿掘須於8月29日或前申請；否則政府會火化後安葬於沙嶺或其他指定地點。
body: 政府周五在憲報刊登命令，通知市民須移走及處置2019年內安葬於六個公眾墳場的先人遺骸。
命令是食物環境衞生署根據《公眾衞生及市政條例》第119A條發出。該條文授權署長指示移走埋葬不少於六年的遺骸。
涉及地點包括粉嶺和合石墳場、長洲墳場、大嶼山大澳墳場及禮智園墳場的棺葬墓段，以及羅湖沙嶺墳場T段及沙嶺金塔墳場的政府金塔墓段。
市民如欲自行安排撿掘及處置，須於今年8月29日或之前親身前往紅磡墳場及火葬場辦事處申請。未按規定處理的遺骸會在政府火葬場火化，骨灰安葬於羅湖沙嶺金塔墳場或署長指定的其他墳場。
